data.text: I’m in. I’ll catch 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. I also commit to the six-ton cap next month, then 10 tons each once the lake is back at 100. My family taught me that this lake sustains our village; this one-time exception helps our neighbors without abandoning that responsibility. Luke, please confirm your zero catch today and six-ton cap next month so all five commitments are explicit before we fish.
